Bug_Title: SIC: Deadly embrace of non-static inner class and thread local (SIC_THREADLOCAL_DEADLY_EMBRACE)
Bug_Details:
This class is an inner class, but should probably be a static inner class.
  As it is, there is a serious danger of a deadly embrace between the inner class
  and the thread local in the outer class. Because the inner class isn't static,
  it retains a reference to the outer class.
  If the thread local contains a reference to an instance of the inner
  class, the inner and outer instance will both be reachable
  and not eligible for garbage collection.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by the InnerClass being a non-static inner class which retains a reference to the OuterClass instance. When a ThreadLocal contains an instance of InnerClass, it creates a situation where both InnerClass and OuterClass instances are mutually referential, preventing them from being garbage collected.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which accesses the InnerClass instance via a ThreadLocal. This setup creates a memory leak due to the non-static nature of InnerClass, which maintains a reference to the OuterClass instance, causing the mutual reference problem described by the bug.
